scope: Completed two recursive Luna rounds and independent Sol source audit before guide implementation. User required A-F remains unfinished, not replaced by a permanent ungraded preview.
acceptedDesign: Same-page top-right Election night scorecard, standard forecast first; alternatives secondary and no saved-user-config or printing feature.
Freeze specific named candidate margins, complete declared race cohorts, source dates and illustrations before outcomes; dated snapshot alone is not an evaluation lock.
Separate winner/group probabilities from conditional named-pair margins, preserving rules/denominators and unsupported targets.
Two sections: actual predictions/results scoreboard; expected error and uncertainty checks. Joint same-election rows remain intact.
Even win probability alone does not establish a genuinely tight margin. Show point/range and actual close/decisive event probabilities where exported.

Score probabilities with proper categorical Brier/log scores; pair margin interval score penalizes both width and misses. Uniform categorical and same-target strong baseline comparisons prevent uninformative forecasts passing as skill.
One election has correlated races, not many independent national shocks. Preserve errors and expected joint shifts without excusing every outcome as possible.
Keep called, provisional, final, certified, unresolved and unsupported separate. No partial count becomes a final margin.
A-F is an editorial communication rule that must be declared before outcomes with transparent baseline/coverage/aggregation choices. No universal numeric thresholds are established by these sources.
corrections: Round1 attribution of 2016 polling report to NCPP corrected to AAPOR/Kennedy et al.
Ranked probability score inappropriate for unordered D/R/Other categories without an ordinal target; use categorical scoring.
2016 PEC final Nov8 probability and earlier statements are separate vintages; modern sidebar is not 2016 evidence.
AAPOR poll-level error denominators and post-outcome battleground subsets must not become predeclared forecast evaluation cohorts.
Gneiting/Raftery JASA proper-scoring paper differs from three-author JRSSB calibration paper; Gelman2020 has four authors.
Legacy docs/election-night-live-mode-design.md is an obsolete proposal, not authority for automated calls or partial-vote updating. Current watcher-guide brief governs.
